status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Thirteen complete proposed mechanical procedures with twenty-six authored examples. NEW completions await actual joint discussion and exact review. No catalog operational field, ordinary approval, class access, runtime, balance or cosmology status changes.

sharedProposal.status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Thirteen complete proposed mechanical procedures with twenty-six authored examples. NEW completions await actual joint discussion and exact review. No catalog operational field, ordinary approval, class access, runtime, balance or cosmology status changes.
sharedProposal.casting: KEEP each actual class access row, rank 4/base 7 RP, minimum class level and repertoire. All thirteen use Action and V/S/F; Summon Corpse Golem preserves V/S/M/F with the existing unpriced material-or-focus alternative. The ordinary casting engine, actual hand/voice/focus requirements, RP discounts and surcharges, Dissonance/Refrain and source hooks apply. Observable legality precedes commitment; hidden defenses or concealed ineligibility give no free diagnostic or refund. Commit the actual Action, costs and cadence before the counter window. A concentration cast displaces incompatible old concentration at commitment even if countered. Attack modifier is actual source PB plus casting modifier; save DC is 8 plus those values. Saves are binary, without natural-die degree shifts. No generic upcast, level scaling, extra turn or unacquired source is supplied.
sharedProposal.clocks: NEW for these cards, durations expressed in minutes/hours use absolute elapsed deadlines from resolution: one minute is sixty seconds and one hour is 3,600 seconds. Expiry precedes a use scheduled at exactly that deadline. A hostile one-round rider uses the first future target regular END excluding the in-progress turn; N future target-end installments use precisely N such endpoints. Outside initiative use the stated 6N seconds. Preserve the chosen virtual marker or absolute deadline through reordering, extra turns, absence, entry and exit from initiative. NEW attached-asset bridge for Mind Maze and Leeching Plague: if the recipient has only a real original-owner attached phase, use its next future attached-phase END excluding a phase already underway; if it has no real turn/phase, use six-second END-only checkpoints. Mapping a checkpoint supplies no ordinary turn, Action, death save, refresh or extra tick. Due effects run before their own ending cleanup. Suppressed scheduled installments are spent without effect; they never accumulate.
sharedProposal.identityAndMultiplicity: NEW explicit group default: one active instance per original caster per ordinary spell ID; a successfully established replacement ends only that caster’s old active instance. An invalid or countered nonconcentration cast leaves the old instance, while ordinary concentration displacement still happens at commitment. A successfully resisted cast establishes nothing and does not replace an old nonconcentration rider. Different owners keep separate source records and endpoints, with stated same-family caps and the existing strongest same-stat flat-bonus rules. Do not generalize that bonus rule into a universal strongest-effect rule. Each record retains caster, class, rank, cast ID, snapshotted spell DC, recipients/anchor, actual history and ending. Transfer, form change or a new database ID cannot rearm it. Nonconcentration voluntary dismissal here requires the original caster’s Action and perception/line of effect to the recipient or anchor within original range; completed instantaneous consequences cannot be recalled.
sharedProposal.perceptionAndIllusions: KEEP actual sight, hearing, Hidden, cover and Invisible rules. Ordinary invisibility does not hide location automatically. Once an observer knows location, it loses only Invisible-specific attack advantage/disadvantage; sight-required targeting still requires actual sight. Resolve a revealing attack first, then give location knowledge only to observers perceiving its evidence. Alternate senses work only within their real scope. NEW apply the current LR-G07 examination procedure to these new visual illusions: an Action with a relevant accessible sense permits INT (Investigation) against the creating spell’s snapshotted DC, using Core degrees/natural shifts then collapsing Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure. Failure permits another attempt only with genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive personally witnessed physical contradiction identifies the false part without a roll. A warning enables examination but does not globally identify the spell for everybody. Images add no actual cover, collision, support, light, sound, creature body, remote senses or inventory unless expressly supplied below. No compelled belief, automatic disguise success or knowledge of hidden terrain is granted.
sharedProposal.damageHealingAndCosts: KEEP typed damage defenses, actual prevention/sharing, buffers, life-state rules, Wounds and concentration. Save-half floors before the relevant defenses. Numeric actualDamageDealt is temporary HP absorbed plus actual normal HP lost, excluding overkill and prevented HP-floor loss. For a permitted drain sum eligible terminal recipient branches once, never both a split parent and its children; apply the card’s narrower funding predicate before its final half/floor. HP restoration uses actual healing restrictions and maximums and grants no automatic Wound cure, resurrection or resource refresh. Direct HP payment is separate from damage: no resistance, buffer, transfer, Wound/damage trigger or damage-derived refund. It must be paid from real normal HP under the card’s explicit floor. No necrotic, shadow, plague or soul name creates an unprinted condition, material, pool or setting fact.
sharedProposal.assetsAndControl: KEEP the real owner-wide one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round. Commands use the owner’s Bonus Action on their regular turn, actual audible/visible communication within sixty feet, and execute in the attached phase after that whole turn. No immediate creation movement/attack and no extra-turn refresh. An issued command survives later owner incapacity only while the actual source and other eligibility survive. Uncommanded assets can move defensively and Dodge, subject to conditions. Current owner-source PB supplies saves; specified base HP/AC remain fixed except genuinely acquired source-qualified modifiers. No borrowed monster abilities or unstated condition/damage immunity. For the two NEW summoned bodies below and Bone Cage only, full suppression of that creating source ends that body/structure immediately rather than storing an intangible replacement. Actual riders or narrowly scoped suppression still affect only their own scope. Ending drops actual cargo/riders at their actual locations with ordinary support/Falling; it creates no salvage, corpse, duplicate equipment or reappearance. This explicit NEW ending rule does not amend other summons.
sharedProposal.hardControlAndMovement: KEEP the source-character/target/encounter hard-denial allowance shared across that owner’s effects. A whole-Action/turn denial spends it only when established; resistance, immunity or an already-used allowance supplies no invented fallback. Soft Speed effects, an obstacle and a numeric attack/save penalty do not themselves spend it. Teleportation relocates without spending Speed, traversing the path or provoking ordinary opportunity attacks. Speed 0 alone is not a relocation prohibition; an actual teleport/relocation prohibition still applies. Verify whole body, actual legal cargo, occupancy and destination before resolution. Only actual carried noncreature belongings travel unless a card expressly permits passengers; another creature, grappled victim, carried living body or mount stays with its own real position/support. No route between planes, custody bypass, resource refill or returned movement budget is implied.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. Choose one willing creature you perceive with line of effect, including yourself. KEEP the target stays Invisible while attacking. NEW replace the contradictory Instantaneous metadata with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. Unlike the reviewed ordinary Invisibility identity, no Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, attack, dealt damage, forced save, spellcasting or other technique ends this effect merely by being used. Actual loss of this spell’s concentration, expiry, qualifying removal or the recipient’s actual death ends it. A different concentration spell cast by its own caster still displaces it normally. The recipient’s actual initial worn/held/carried noncreature gear within its lawful anatomy and capacity shares visual concealment while that same item remains in its possession. Dropped, fired or transferred items immediately become visible; regripping one later does not restore this cast’s concealment, and newly picked-up external property never gains it. No carried creature, mount or independently living body is concealed by that gear clause. Existing melded property retains its real body/equipment history without creating a second visible item. Ordinary voice, footfalls, tracks, light emitted by actual equipment and physical interaction remain real. A revealing attack can leave the creature Invisible while observers learn its location and lose only the Invisible-specific attack modifiers. Neither location knowledge nor Investigation grants sight through this actual condition; use an actual qualifying sense/removal. Suppression suspends this record’s concealment while its original deadline runs; it neither deletes observer knowledge nor restores a spent/released item to the initial gear set. Multiple owners’ sources retain separate concentration records, with no stacked Invisible benefit. There is no continuing caster-to-target range tether after application.
proposals.newChoices: NEW willing recipient, sixty-second concentration and explicit no-action-ending scope, initial-only gear set, death endpoint and observer-specific information handling. The stronger printed attack exception is retained; reviewed ordinary Invisibility and Mislead stay unchanged.
workedCases: IN4-01-A: Bea receives the spell at t=0 with her worn armor and bow. She attacks at t=8; the revealing attack resolves before an observing guard learns her location. She remains Invisible, but that guard gains no continuing Invisible-specific disadvantage merely from her unseen appearance. The fired arrow becomes visible when released.

IN4-01-B: At t=20 Bea picks up a visible key; it remains visible. Full effect suppression at t=30 suspends her concealment until t=40, but the original t=60 deadline and the guard’s knowledge persist. If the original caster starts another concentration spell at t=45, this record ends even if that new spell is countered.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 150 feet; V/S/F. KEEP an area appearing as another terrain. NEW choose a perceived supported terrain center within 150 feet and line of effect; the stationary horizontal footprint has radius up to seventy-five feet, so its maximum horizontal span is the printed 150 feet. Its visual depiction occupies at most thirty feet above or below the chosen center, clipped by real barriers and the terrain actually perceived when composed. Replace Instantaneous with concentration up to one hour. At casting specify one static visual terrain appearance based on actual known/perceived shapes: stone can appear grassy, safe ground can look broken, or visible shallow water can look like a dry bed. It does not reveal or accurately reconstruct concealed geography. NEW only background terrain appearance changes: creatures, independently carried objects, buildings, vehicles, doors, mechanisms and actual light sources remain visibly themselves; it cannot paint a concealing opaque surface over them. It may disguise a perceived natural pit or apparent footing, but the illusion provides no real floor. It does not remove actual visual obstruction: a real boulder painted as grass still blocks sight/line of effect and physically obstructs passage. A false boulder on empty ground adds no mechanical blocked sight, cover or collision. No sound, smell, temperature, touch, harvest, difficult-terrain modifier, navigation success or forced movement is created. Observers can make the shared examination or witness conclusive contradiction; an informed observer can distinguish the false appearance without seeing through real obstacles. The image is fixed to its initial world area and never follows a vehicle or relocates with uprooted terrain. Newly exposed ground or arriving objects are not newly mapped or given an intelligently adapted image; actual departures/changed objects can supply evidence of the false overlay. There is no independent image control after casting. Overlapping such depictions retain separate records; NEW at a shared visual surface only the latest successful depiction is presented, with an older still-active one becoming apparent if the later one ends. Knowing one does not automatically identify an independently different illusion. Suppression removes only the affected source appearance while its clock runs; concentration loss, expiry or removal ends it.
proposals.newChoices: NEW 150-foot maximum span distinct from 150-foot casting range, thirty-foot vertical bound, one-hour concentration and terrain-only static image. Explicitly no body masking, false mechanical opacity or new physical terrain; latest depiction handles overlapping appearances without deleting sources.
workedCases: IN4-02-A: A perceived natural ten-foot pit lies inside the chosen footprint. It is painted as ordinary ground, but a pole passes through the false surface and reveals that contradiction to its observer. Stepping there still invokes the real fall; successful Investigation creates neither support nor a safe route.

IN4-02-B: The center is 150 feet away and the chosen radius is 75 feet, giving a 150-foot span rather than a 150-foot radius. A wagon entering the area remains visible. A real stone wall remains a physical and sight barrier even if its surface has been painted with a grass-like appearance.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes WIS. Success establishes nothing. KEEP failure loses one round in confusion. NEW on a failed save, if actual defenses permit and the shared hard-control allowance is unused, establish a custom lost-round state immediately until the end of the target’s next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn. There is no concentration; this ongoing rank-4 rider expressly survives the original Instantaneous metadata and is subject to qualifying removal/suppression. It prohibits new full Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and voluntary movement commitments. Already legally committed Actions/Reactions finish their actual resolution; movement already spent is not refunded, while later uncommitted movement cannot begin. Extra turns inside the interval gain no exception and do not shorten the endpoint. The target still makes actual required saves, death saves and ending checks, can perceive/think and use permitted speech, retains passive defenses and can be moved by independent forces. This is not Stunned, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Blinded or the ordinary Confusion spell; it imposes no automatic failed saves, attack advantage, forced hostile attack or concentration loss by itself. Ordinary damage or a separately applicable incapacitating state still affects concentration normally. Apply the shared future attached-phase/six-second bridge where the recipient has no regular turn, without inventing a companion turn. Consume the source-character/target/encounter guard only on establishment; an already spent guard or relevant immunity blocks this entire lost-round state, with no replacement penalty. Charmed-only immunity does not cover a rider that imposes no Charmed condition; actual broader defenses apply. Suppression permits whatever normal actions are otherwise legal while suppressed, without restoring budgets already spent or extending the endpoint. The used hard-control allowance remains used after early removal or suppression. No repeat save is added; expiry/removal/death of the recipient ends the rider. No teleportation or stopped personal time occurs.
proposals.newChoices: NEW exact lost-round permissions, future target-END duration, hard-control guard, attached-phase bridge and continued passive/concentration handling. No imported condition or random behavior table.
workedCases: IN4-03-A: Mind Maze resolves during Lio’s round-3 turn after he committed an attack. He fails WIS with an unused hard-control allowance. The committed attack finishes, but he cannot spend a later Bonus Action or resume voluntary movement. The state persists through his round-4 regular END; an extra turn before that does not release him.

IN4-03-B: The same caster previously established a hard-denial effect on Lio this encounter. A new failed WIS save does not establish Mind Maze or invent a -1 fallback. Against another legal target, suppression can temporarily permit normal available actions, but never restores the already consumed hard-control allowance.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP one clone mimicking the caster and a place swap once per round. NEW create one visual-only duplicate of your actual current body and gear appearance at a perceived position within sixty feet and line of effect, with enough geometric room for the depicted body. It has your current silhouette and occupied dimensions, but no creature identity, HP, physical gear, collision, attack, senses or targetable creature status. Replace Instantaneous with concentration up to sixty seconds. Its pose and gestures mirror your visible bodily motion without duplicating speech, light or effects. NEW when you perform actual self-powered movement, it translates by the same vector, segment by segment, preserving its offset; a segment that would move it outside sixty feet, through an actual solid barrier or out of caster line of effect leaves it at its last legal image position. It then keeps mimicking in place until a later legal segment; it banks no missed movement. Forced displacement and teleportation do not translate it. It has no independent move command or initiative budget. Once on your own regular turn, spend an available Bonus Action to exchange your actual position with the clone’s current depicted position. Both positions must still be perceived and within sixty feet/line of effect, the arrival must legally fit your actual full body and carried noncreature gear, and actual relocation prohibitions must permit it. NEW supported destinations are required unless you already have a legal flight/hover or other support mode for that actual arrival. The swap is instantaneous, has no path traversal/opportunity attack and moves no carried creature or mount. The new image occupies your old location; it does not trigger a second translation. Commit the Bonus Action and the character-wide Illusory Clone swap allowance before resolving an eligible swap; later prevention refunds neither. The allowance is once per numbered round across casts, owners of copied permission and extra turns; outside initiative use the continuing six-second action budget and preserve the open allowance on transition. Casting can be followed by a swap if the real Bonus Action remains. The clone can be scrutinized/contradicted under the shared illusion rules. It supplies no Mirror Image random interception, mis-targeting requirement, invisibility, attack defense or ability to swap in response to a hit. Suppression prevents visual operation and swapping, while maintaining the last position, original clock and spent swap history; resumption does not catch up movement.
proposals.newChoices: NEW concentration minute, nonphysical body-matching visual image, bounded mirrored translation and own-turn Bonus Action swap with legal geometry and persistent once/round history. No inherited Mirror Image defense or Mislead invisibility.
workedCases: IN4-04-A: The clone appears twenty feet east of Arin. Arin walks ten feet north; if the corresponding image segment is legal, it also moves ten feet north. Arin then spends his Bonus Action to swap. His old space now contains only the image, his actual carried bow moves once, and no second body or new movement budget exists.

IN4-04-B: Arin has swapped in round 6. An extra turn or replacement clone cannot supply another round-6 swap. If an actual obstruction makes the destination illegal before resolution, the committed allowance stays spent. A later enemy attack is resolved against its genuinely selected legal target; the clone provides no random interception.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP creation of a phantom steed with special abilities. NEW create one Large quadruped in a perceived unoccupied supported ten-foot space with line of effect; replace Instantaneous with concentration up to one hour. Complete profile: AC 14, normal HP 20, walking Speed 60 feet, body mass 1,000 pounds, ordinary sight/hearing, saves current original-owner PB and other checks +0. It understands actual conveyed owner commands, but has no speech, remote senses, telepathy, attacks, spellcasting, equipment proficiencies, damage resistance or condition immunity. One willing Small/Medium rider; maximum combined real rider/tack/cargo 350 pounds and 35 Load, satisfying both limits and actual body fit. It creates no saddle/tack; ordinary bareback mounting/dismounting from within five feet costs half the rider’s current walking Speed in movement expenditure, needs a legal destination and cannot be voluntarily done at Speed 0. NEW choose exactly one special mode on casting, fixed for this instance: (A) Water Tread, walking on the actual surface of ordinary liquid water as support; (B) Surefoot, ignore only movement-cost doubling from mundane loose rubble or vegetation underfoot; or (C) Winged, a 40-foot flying Speed without hover. Water Tread does not protect a submerged/dismounted rider, traverse lava, still waves, ignore hazards or supply a bridge for anyone else. Surefoot grants no climb/burrow, safe footing, immunity to traps, magical terrain or falling. Winged grants actual flight only while eligible and active; rider/cargo weight still applies and lost support uses normal Falling. Different movement modes share actual spent movement, without a fresh budget on switching. A legal shared Bonus Action command authorizes movement and one nonoffensive Dash, Dodge or Disengage in its attached phase. No offensive permission, autonomous travel, free creation movement or rider Action is added. Outside initiative account for actual repeated control, terrain, elapsed moving time and ordinary expedition rules; no automatic superior miles-per-hour rate follows from its tactical Speed. It needs no food, water, sleep or breath, but the rider does, and it grants no safe Rest or Supply. A later acquired source-qualified HP modifier follows the actual ledger and never refills a damaged mount merely by changing capacity. At zero HP, concentration end, expiry, qualifying removal or full creating-source suppression it ends under the shared asset rule; actual rider/cargo remain in place. Real damage/healing never renews its duration, command history or special-mode choice. No corpse, tack, feather, meat, harvest or permanent animal is produced.
proposals.newChoices: NEW complete mount profile, hour-long concentration, one fixed choice of Water Tread/Surefoot/Winged, both weight and Load limits, source-specific suppression ending and explicit real travel/command handling. Reviewed lesser Phantom Steed remains its own hour-long nonconcentration profile.
workedCases: IN4-05-A: A 170-pound rider, 25 pounds of gear and 10-pound tack total 205 pounds and 20.5 Load, within both capacities. Winged mode supplies Fly 40, but mounting and the owner’s actual command still precede the attached movement. The casting Action itself grants no immediate forty-foot flight.

IN4-05-B: A Winged steed is forty feet above actual ground when full source suppression ends it. Rider and saddlebags remain at that height and use the existing Falling procedure; they are neither silently lowered nor deleted. A replacement costs a new legal cast and inherits the owner’s already spent command/offense history for that round.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; Instantaneous. KEEP teleportation between areas of darkness. NEW the sole recipient is the caster. At commitment and resolution your whole occupied body must lie in actual darkness, and one perceived destination within sixty feet must contain your whole arriving body in actual darkness. Dim light alone fails this predicate. Ordinary darkness and magical darkness both qualify as illumination states only where their actual effects establish darkness; that does not grant the senses to perceive a destination inside them. Perception must identify the actual legal space through an independently sufficient current sense; a guessed square, remembered unseen room, magical aura or claimed shadow is insufficient. NEW like the reviewed Elemental Displacement destination exception, no clear physical path or intervening line of effect is required to an actually perceived destination; a transparent physical barrier may be bypassed if no actual ward prohibits that relocation. No cross-plane route or unseen endpoint is created. Arrival must be unoccupied, contain your actual body and legal carried noncreature property, and have actual support or your independently functioning movement/support mode; this card disallows deliberately unsupported arrivals without one. No other creature, mount or grappled target travels. You spend no Speed and provoke no ordinary opportunity attack; actual restraints/relocation prohibitions retain their scopes, and breaking a maintained grapple relationship uses its own rules. If darkness, perception, occupancy or another required fact fails after commitment, the paid cast moves nothing and does not select a replacement space. It grants no Invisible condition, silence, attack damage rider, new Action, return journey or renewed movement/Reaction budget. The Monk Hero Shadow Step and Oracle Arch Shadow Step remain separate class techniques with their own actual prices, activation, range and riders.
proposals.newChoices: NEW self-only whole-body darkness checks, both-endpoint eligibility, independently perceived destination/path exception, support and atomic payload. No class-feature riders or inferred setting route.
workedCases: IN4-06-A: The caster stands wholly in darkness and can actually see a dark landing forty-five feet away using a sufficient existing sense. The space fits and is supported. One paid Action moves the caster and legally held gear, spending no Speed; a grappled creature stays behind and the real grapple relationship is reevaluated.

IN4-06-B: The destination is only dimly lit, or magical darkness prevents every actual sense from perceiving its legal space. The attempt is observably illegal before commitment. If a real light is introduced only after a legal cast commits, resolution fails without refund or automatic search for another dark square.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/M/F, using an actual unpriced material-or-focus alternative; KEEP concentration up to one minute and HP 60, 2d10 slam and slow aura. NEW create one Large construct companion in an unoccupied supported ten-foot space perceived within range and line of effect. It is a temporary summoned body with corpse-like appearance, not an animation of an actual dead identity; no corpse input, ownership or soul fact is inferred. Base AC 15, normal HP 60, walk 20 feet, body mass 600 pounds, ordinary vision/hearing, saves current original-owner PB, other checks +0. It understands owner commands but has no speech/telepathy; no unstated construct immunities. It has two manipulators for its slam and carrying at most forty pounds/four Load of fitting incidental cargo, no tool proficiency, fine crafting, armor or weapon proficiency. A legal commanded Slam is one melee spell attack using the original casting source’s current modifier, reach five feet, hit 2d10 bludgeoning with no ability modifier; natural critical doubles only the dice to 4d10. NEW Slow Aura is an alternative commanded offensive Action instead of Slam. It opens a ten-foot-radius field centered on the golem until the owner’s next future regular START, or earlier golem/source ending. Declare the owner’s ordinary known opposition set on activation; this is not an alignment/hidden-intent detector. Eligible enemies with golem-to-target line of effect at activation or first later entry make CON against the cast’s snapshotted DC once for that activation. Failure halves Speed only while actually inside that active aura with line of effect; success ignores that activation. Leaving suppresses the failed-save slowdown, reentering the same activation restores it without another save. A creature cannot acquire two half-Speed multipliers from overlapping golems; use actual strongest adverse-Speed arbitration before later systemic multipliers. No AC/DEX penalty, full-Action ceiling, Reaction denial, Prone, hard-control claim or ordinary Slow mode is imported. Activation spends the shared offensive allowance even if all save; its finite later entry checks need no second command and grant no new companion action. A fresh activation requires a later genuinely available offensive command. Without it the golem has no automatically active aura. Use the actual attached phase; its creation grants neither a slam nor aura. At zero HP, expiry, concentration loss, qualifying removal or full creating-source suppression the body/aura end without corpse/salvage; actual cargo remains. One golem per caster and all actual control caps still apply. Healing does not renew its source or command records.
proposals.newChoices: NEW Large construct chassis, AC 15/Speed 20/600-pound body, focus mapping without corpse input, and explicitly commanded short slow aura as an alternative to the printed slam. This command tradeoff and finite aura need joint balance review; no profile is borrowed.
workedCases: IN4-07-A: The caster’s Bonus Action commands Slam and spends the shared offensive allowance. After the caster’s whole turn, the golem reaches a legal target and hits for a rolled 2d10 total of 13. It cannot also open its Slow Aura, and another owned device cannot use another offensive companion Action that numbered round.

IN4-07-B: In the next legal round the caster commands Slow Aura instead. An enemy inside fails CON: Speed 30 becomes 15 under the adverse-Speed rule. Leaving the ten-foot region removes that field’s active slowdown; reentering before its original owner-START endpoint restores the failed-save effect, with no second save, Action loss or new control allowance.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP 2d6 per round for four rounds and healing the caster for half. NEW choose one perceived creature with line of effect; it makes CON. Success establishes no effect. Failure attaches a nonconcentration magical stream with exactly four 2d6 necrotic installments at its next four future regular END markers, excluding an in-progress turn. There is no immediate fifth packet, attack roll, attack critical or repeat ending save. Outside initiative use +6/+12/+18/+24 seconds; use the shared attached-phase bridge where required. Each due installment rolls separately, applies current actual defenses/sharing and consumes its opportunity even if suppressed or reduced to zero. NEW heal the original caster once by floor(eligible actualDamageDealt/2) after that installment’s damage/life consequences finish. Eligible funding is limited to terminal damage received by genuinely hostile living nonconstruct actual encounter opponents; self, allies, controlled donors, helpless captives, corpses and no-resource summoned/copied bodies contribute zero. Those predicates constrain the heal, not whether the initial creature is a legal damage target. Eligible temporary-HP absorption and actual normal-HP loss count; overkill, prevented loss, an unsplit parent counted again and unrelated reflected/counterdamage do not. Sum eligible recipient branches once and then floor half once. The actual caster must still be a continuing living recipient of legal healing; zero HP alone is not death and normal recovery rules apply. A dead/ended caster receives no heal and cannot redirect it to an heir, proxy, replacement body record or companion. If actual absence leaves no valid receiving body under the source, skip that heal without banking it. Ordinary distance and loss of initial sight alone do not end this established nonconcentration stream or create a new recipient. Actual target death/ended identity ends future installments; zero HP alone follows its real life rules. Source death does not cancel already established damage installments, but supplies no post-death heal. Each installment’s secondary healing invokes only independently eligible healing hooks and cannot reproduce the drain or another heal from the same packet. A successful same-caster replacement ends the old remaining schedule; other owners have separate paid streams. Qualifying dispel ends the stream; immunity to Disease or removal of Disease alone does not, because this spell adds no Disease, contagion, healing prohibition or physical pathogen.
proposals.newChoices: NEW initial CON-negates application, necrotic type, exactly four future-END installments without concentration, explicitly restricted numeric actual-damage heal including eligible buffers, and source/recipient life-state handling. Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch and Soul Tap retain their nonidentical funding rules.
workedCases: IN4-08-A: The first installment rolls 9 against a qualifying enemy with 3 temporary HP and 4 normal HP. With no prevention, numeric actual damage is 3+4=7, not the overkill-inclusive 9; the caster’s one base heal is floor(7/2)=3, then actual healing limits apply. If that enemy dies, the three remaining opportunities end.

IN4-08-B: A surviving target receives the stream outside initiative at t=0. Opportunities are t=6,12,18,24. Suppression at t=12 spends that installment without damage/heal; lifting it at t=13 adds no replacement tick. There was no initial t=0 damage, so the maximum remains four installments.

proposals.procedure: Action; printed range 10 feet; V/S/F. KEEP enemies within ten feet suffer -1 on saves/attacks. NEW interpret the range as an aura centered on the caster’s actual body and moving with it; replace Instantaneous with concentration up to sixty seconds. Before each affected roll, determine membership from occupied-space distance at most ten feet and actual line of effect from the caster. The caster’s declared ordinary opposition set determines enemy membership; it supplies no supernatural alignment, intention, invisible-target or hidden-location knowledge. Designating a known foe does not require sight to maintain membership if actual distance/line of effect hold, and membership is not a detection report. NEW no initial or repeat save. An eligible creature subtracts one from its attack rolls and saving throws made while the aura is active; no ability check, damage, AC, initiative, spell DC or save DC penalty is added. Snapshot the modifier for that actual roll immediately before dice, after genuine pre-roll interruptions. Leaving after the die does not change the completed result; being outside at the roll gains no delayed penalty. Entry and exit require no new exposure roll, and a second Aura of Dread from any owner never adds another -1; removal of one leaves any independently active other aura. Other differently sourced penalties interact only under their real rules, without inventing a universal exclusion or additional die allowance. It is not Frightened, Charmed, psychic damage, disadvantage or a command: fear-only immunity does not defeat this numeric penalty, while a genuinely applicable broader ward can. The Core Damage tag grants no damage. Suppression suspends membership penalties while the clock runs; loss of concentration/expiry/removal ends this source, and no pending curse follows former entrants.
proposals.newChoices: NEW moving caster-centered aura, minute concentration, no save, continuous per-roll membership and nonstacking duplicate -1. Enemy declaration is a targeting convention, not a mind/alignment detector; the Damage tag adds nothing.
workedCases: IN4-09-A: An enemy is eight feet from the caster with line of effect when it rolls an attack: natural 12 plus its actual +5 minus 1 totals 16. It later leaves the aura before another attack and uses the ordinary modifier for that later roll. No retroactive change affects the first result.

IN4-09-B: Two active casters’ auras overlap the same enemy. Its save suffers -1 total from Aura of Dread, not -2. Fear immunity alone changes nothing because no Frightened state is applied; an actual wall blocking both sources’ line of effect prevents their penalties.

proposals.procedure: Action; V/S/F; Instantaneous. PRESERVE THE SOURCE CONFLICT: current catalog says sacrifice 20 HP to recover up to 3 RP, while Core says recover 5 RP and lists range 60 feet/base cost 7 RP. PROPOSED CONFLICT CHOICE: use the current catalog’s up-to-three recovery, retain the full actual rank-4/base-seven casting price, and make the recipient the caster’s own RP pool. The old five-RP and sixty-foot fields remain beside this explicit self-only interpretation. NEW one character-wide Soulburn Pact use per actual beneficial completed long rest, shared across classes/copies and never refreshed by replacement, form change or nonbeneficial rest. Require an unused use, actual legal components/action and enough current RP for the genuinely computed casting price; anticipated recovery cannot pay it. Also require enough normal HP to pay all applicable real HP costs while remaining at least 1 HP, so this spell alone requires at least 21 current normal HP. At legal commitment atomically spend the Action, actual computed RP price, this use and exactly twenty normal HP before the counter window. The twenty is direct HP cost, not damage: temporary/form HP, resistance, immunity, HP floors, redirection and on-damage recovery cannot satisfy or discount it. An actual rule preventing that full cost makes the cast illegal; do not treat prevented payment as paid. A countered cast leaves all committed payments/use spent and recovers no RP. At successful resolution choose an integer recovery from zero through three, capped by genuinely missing RP in the same actual pool. Excess is lost; no bank, ally transfer, RC/other-pool substitution, Dissonance/Refrain reduction or recovery of the paid transaction is granted. Actual independently acquired RP-price discounts/waivers retain their written scope and can change the upfront price; they never change the twenty-HP payment or this one-use limit. Copied output cannot duplicate the recovery, and independently allowed fresh casts still need the unused character-wide use. NEW this preserves a deliberately inefficient ordinary transaction: without discounts/surcharges, paying seven then recovering three produces a net loss of four RP plus twenty HP. Its usefulness and the competing five-RP source are explicit design issues for joint review, not grounds to invent a free cast or silently promote a replacement design. No soul consumption, theology, life debt or corruption is established.
proposals.newChoices: PROPOSED source conflict choice: up to 3 RP and self only; original 5-RP/range-60 alternative retained. NEW pre-counter twenty-normal-HP payment with 1-HP floor, one character-wide beneficial-rest use and actual-cost-before-recovery ordering. The negative ordinary resource yield is openly flagged.
workedCases: IN4-10-A: With no discount/surcharge, a caster begins with 12 RP and 31 normal HP. Legal commitment leaves 5 RP and 11 HP, with the one use spent. Successful recovery of 3 leaves 8 RP. If countered, the result stays 5 RP/11 HP; no recovery finances the original seven-RP payment.

IN4-10-B: A caster has only 6 RP or exactly 20 normal HP, with no genuine cost exception. The cast cannot commit. Temporary HP does not cure either shortage. A real price waiver could alter only the RP check; it still requires the twenty-HP payment, unused named use and all other eligibility.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; Instantaneous. KEEP 8d8 necrotic, with a greater effect against plants. NEW choose one perceived creature with line of effect; it makes CON, failure full and success half. Roll once for that one target. NEW a target whose actual present creature profile expressly establishes Plant type or a qualifying living plant body receives two additional d8 in that same event, for 10d8 instead of 8d8, still with the same CON half save. A name, green appearance, wooden armor, a plant-themed class feature or an unsupported anatomical claim does not establish that predicate. An actual completed transformation that explicitly changes the body to a living plant can qualify; merely wearing such a disguise cannot. Mixed bodies use their actual governing type/body record, never twice-counted portions or an invented percentage. This adds no automatic maximum dice, save disadvantage, vulnerability, death, healing suppression, Curse or campaign Blight/Corruption. Actual necrotic and other relevant defenses still apply independently of plant eligibility. NEW separate mundane-plant mode: one actual living noncreature plant no larger than Large, fitting within a ten-foot occupied footprint, may be selected if independently perceived with line of effect and with a real tracked durability/profile. It receives the same 10d8 event and its own explicit CON save if its actual profile supplies one; ordinary inanimate plant matter with no such save automatically fails, without borrowing a nearby owner’s save or inventing an ability score. Do not split a tree/forest into arbitrary cheaper targets, assume untracked HP, target every carried wooden object or damage all roots/neighboring plants. Dead wood, harvested ingredients and ordinary plant-derived gear are ineligible for this mundane living-plant mode. The one real object’s damage/destruction and surviving matter use actual object rules; neither damage nor a successful roll creates a crop yield, new harvest entitlement, ingredient grade or instant usable resource. The Druid Blight Elk and Ranger Blight Infusion remain distinct features. No area effect, concentration or continuing damage is added.
proposals.newChoices: NEW CON half, finite +2d8 living-plant enhancement, actual body/type qualification and a narrow single tracked mundane-plant mode. No familiar external maximization/disadvantage/auto-kill package.
workedCases: IN4-11-A: A documented Plant creature receives one 10d8 roll of 47. A successful CON save gives 23; necrotic resistance then gives 11 before other actual prevention. It is neither automatically destroyed nor assigned a separate second hit for the extra two dice.

IN4-11-B: A nonplant creature wearing wooden armor receives the ordinary 8d8 procedure, and its armor takes no automatic damage. A separately tracked living shrub can qualify for the mundane-plant mode; a crate of already harvested herbs cannot, and neither outcome generates a new harvest claim.

proposals.procedure: Action; Self; V/S/F. KEEP a self-shroud of shadows and resistance to damage. NEW replace Instantaneous with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. The caster gains resistance to every actual damage type while this source is active, rather than silently narrowing the printed broad protection to a familiar outside spell’s list. Apply resistance once per typed component at the actual defense stage; another resistance to the same type does not quarter it, and actual vulnerability/immunity interactions follow the existing pipeline. Mixed typed components retain their single-event identity. Direct HP payments, maximum-HP changes, state assignments, loss of temporary HP unrelated to damage and genuine non-damage costs are not damage and gain no resistance. NEW the visible shadow shroud is a cosmetic appearance following the actual body and its lawful worn gear within its occupied space. It does not alter ambient light, produce an area of darkness, create physical cover, obscure the body, grant Invisible/Hidden, defeat a special sense or modify sight-required targeting. It adds no retaliatory strike, necrotic damage, attack advantage, enemy fear or conditional immunity. Damage that still reaches the caster has its ordinary concentration consequences using the correctly resolved packet; this source grants no exception to those checks. Actual concentration loss ends future resistance after the triggering damage event resolves, never retroactively increasing that event. Suppression suspends the resistance and shroud while the absolute deadline continues; it restores neither lost concentration nor canceled damage. Actual underlying other defenses remain independently active when this source ends. Equipment retains its actual identity and receives no independent blanket resistance merely from being pictured in the shroud.
proposals.newChoices: NEW sixty-second concentration and explicitly cosmetic shadow appearance. Preserve broad all-damage resistance with native typed arbitration, no retaliation or hidden darkness package.
workedCases: IN4-12-A: A caster receives a resolved raw fire amount of 19 before resistance. This source and another fire resistance still yield only one halving to 9. The resulting real packet can require a concentration check; a failure ends future protection without replaying the nine as nineteen.

IN4-12-B: The caster makes a separately legal twenty-HP direct payment. Shadow of Moil does not halve it because that payment is not damage. A nearby observer still sees the caster in ordinary illumination, so the cosmetic shadows cannot be used as Shadow Step’s required actual darkness.

proposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP creation of a bone cage to trap one creature. NEW select one perceived Large-or-smaller creature and a fixed supported cage position around its actual current body with line of effect. Interior is a ten-foot cube; the frame occupies at most one additional foot outward on each face, giving a twelve-foot exterior cube. Its base must have actual support for a 100-pound structure plus whatever load it already actually bears, with no new bridge/floor spanning a void. The cage is an immovable anchored structure, not a portable vehicle. Before commitment its whole frame must fit without intersecting other creatures, real barriers or displacing the target; no free cutting, crushing, lift or insertion through a wall. The selected target makes DEX. Success causes this proposed cage to fail to form, without a free dodge movement or enclosure of an alternative creature. Failure forms it if placement remains legal. NEW replace Instantaneous with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. It has one tracked structure AC 15 and HP 30 across all faces, with vertical bars separated by three-inch gaps; no separate cheaper bar/hinge HP is invented. Bone-like conjured material is resource-ineligible. The captive has its actual movement inside, Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, speech, senses and component capability; trapped does not impose Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Silence or hard-Action denial. Actual anatomy small enough to fit a three-inch gap may pass using ordinary movement; no whole-body passage is inferred solely from a Tiny label. The bars supply NEW half cover, +2 AC and DEX saves, only to a target whose actual attack/effect path crosses them under the ordinary cover rule. They do not block sight or all line of effect, prevent a fitting reach/weapon from passing, or create an automatic line to something otherwise hidden. Actual physical projectiles/objects must fit a gap. Spells retain their own targeting/geometry and only damage this structure if they really include objects. A reachable legal object attack from inside or outside uses the cage’s one AC/HP record; ordinary object type defenses apply, with NEW no additional cage resistance/immunity. At zero structure HP the entire cage ends, leaving a normal opening and actual bodies/cargo in place. NEW an adjacent creature can instead spend an Action on STR (Athletics) against the spell’s snapshotted DC; Core Success/Critical Success permanently bends open one chosen whole ten-foot face of this instance, while failure changes nothing and a later paid attempt is allowed. This work causes no damage to the captive and no damage-derived trigger. A legal teleport can leave; Speed 0 or a restraint immunity is not a general cage escape, and the cage adds no teleport ban. The empty cage remains until ending/replacement, never pursuing its former captive or re-closing an opened face. Concentration loss, expiry, qualifying removal or full creating-source suppression ends the structure permanently under the shared rule, with no renewable bones or later reformation around entrants.
proposals.newChoices: NEW bounded supported geometry, DEX-negates formation, concentration minute, one AC 15/HP 30 structure, exact gaps/half-cover and Action STR-opening procedure. The cage is a physical obstacle, without imported hard conditions or teleport ban; no resource bones are created.
workedCases: IN4-13-A: A Medium target fails DEX inside a legal supported cage. It can still cast using its actual voice/hands and can use a genuinely available legal teleport through the visible bars. A later foe’s attack crossing the bars applies half cover if the ordinary attack geometry qualifies; the cage does not erase the target’s whole Action.

IN4-13-B: An ally adjacent to the cage spends an Action, rolls Athletics 11+4 against DC 15 and succeeds, opening one whole ten-foot face. That passage remains open for this instance. A later full source suppression ends the remaining frame rather than storing it for reappearance, and no bone material enters inventory.

explicitJointIssues: Greater Invisibility proposes the full action/attack exemption and willing target at sixty feet, while retaining the native observer-specific location rules. Compare the now-reviewed ordinary Invisibility and Mislead records, not stale preparation labels.

Hallucinatory Terrain interprets 150 feet as both casting range and maximum horizontal span, with a thirty-foot vertical limit and one-hour concentration. Terrain appearance cannot conceal creatures or remove real occlusion. Confirm this finite utility and overlap rule.

Mind Maze is a custom whole-round denial under the existing shared hard guard. It does not silently become Stunned/Incapacitated or end concentration; its attached-phase bridge and committed-action handling need exact review.

Illusory Clone proposes a visual image with bounded mirrored translation and an own-turn Bonus Action swap. Its once-per-round ledger survives recast and extra turns; it is neither Mirror Image defense nor Mislead invisibility.

Greater Phantom Steed proposes three fixed alternative specialties and one-hour concentration. Review flight, weight/Load, real control/travel and the contrast with the lesser nonconcentration steed; none certifies transport balance.

Shadow Step keeps Action/sixty feet and requires actual darkness at both ends plus independent destination perception. The same-named Monk/Oracle techniques retain their separate gates, costs and riders.

Corpse Golem proposes a temporary construct without a real corpse input, retaining HP 60 and 2d10. Its slow aura is a separately commanded offensive alternative to Slam, with bounded duration and CON/half-Speed membership. Confirm this deliberate action-economy completion.

Leeching Plague proposes CON-negates application, four future-END damage opportunities, no concentration and restricted numeric actual-damage healing. Buffers can fund its heal; this intentionally differs from Soul Tap’s normal-HP-only transaction and preserves all older spell predicates.

Aura of Dread proposes a no-save minute concentration aura for the printed flat -1. It affects attacks and saves only, grants no fear/hidden-intent readout and duplicates do not sum. Confirm its interaction with genuinely independent penalty sources.

Soulburn Pact has a literal current 3-RP versus Core 5-RP conflict and a retained 7-RP base price. This proposal selects up to three without concealing its negative resource yield, adds a one-use beneficial-rest limit and pays twenty normal HP before countering. The amount, utility and added frequency are material joint design decisions.

Blight’s plant enhancement is explicitly +2d8 with the same CON half save, not maximization, disadvantage or automatic death. Mundane plant targeting needs actual finite identity/durability and grants no free harvest.

Shadow of Moil retains broad resistance to all damage with cosmetic-only shadows, minute concentration and native defense ordering. Broad mitigation is a material balance issue; no external retaliation or darkness rule is imported.

Bone Cage proposes a finite breakable object with DEX-negates formation and half cover, preserving target actions and ordinary relocation. Confirm whole-frame placement, three-inch gaps and the ten-foot-face opening procedure.

The proposed full-source-suppression ending for these two summons and Bone Cage is explicitly NEW and local to this cohort. It drops actual supported bodies/cargo normally and cannot retroactively change the handling of any previously reviewed summon.
